# CPL Season: Full LLM Reference

> Structured context for CPL Season, an independent website covering the
> 2026 Republic Bank Caribbean Premier League.

## Site identity

- Canonical origin: https://cplseason.com/
- Coverage: schedules, match pages, standings, teams, squads, player profiles, venues, broadcast information, and news.
- Relationship to CPL: independent information site; not the official Caribbean Premier League website.
- Latest source-data update represented here: 2026-07-29.

## 2026 tournament snapshot

- Competition: Republic Bank Caribbean Premier League 2026.
- Scheduled matches: 39.
- Tournament window: 7 August 2026 to 20 September 2026.
- Teams represented: 7.
- Host venues represented: 8.
- Player profiles: 122.
- Published news articles: 16.
- Match times are local to the host venue unless a page explicitly states otherwise.
- Fixtures, squads, broadcasters, playing XIs, results, and standings may change.

## Teams and published rosters

### [Antigua & Barbuda Falcons](https://cplseason.com/team/antigua-barbuda-falcons/)

- Territory: Antigua and Barbuda.
- Home venue: [Sir Vivian Richards Stadium](https://cplseason.com/venue/sir-vivian-richards-stadium/).
- League fixtures: 10; home matches: 4.
- Profile: The Falcons bring Antiguan fast bowler Alzarri Joseph home for 2026 and add Evin Lewis to a returning core that includes Fabian Allen, Jayden Seales and Amir Jangoo.
- 2026 storyline: Their route begins on opening night in St Vincent before a four-match home block at Sir Vivian Richards Stadium from 20 to 25 August.
- Published roster:
  - [Alzarri Joseph](https://cplseason.com/player/alzarri-joseph/)

### [Barbados Tridents](https://cplseason.com/team/barbados-royals/)

- Territory: Barbados.
- Home venue: [Kensington Oval](https://cplseason.com/venue/kensington-oval/).
- League fixtures: 10; home matches: 5.
- Profile: Barbados return to the Tridents identity and national colours in 2026, with Gudakesh Motie, Sherfane Rutherford and Brandon King among the senior Caribbean core.
- 2026 storyline: Kensington Oval stages five Barbados league matches and then all four playoff games, giving the franchise a home finish to the regular season.
- Published roster:

### [Guyana Amazon Warriors](https://cplseason.com/team/guyana-amazon-warriors/)

- Territory: Guyana.
- Home venue: [Providence Stadium](https://cplseason.com/venue/providence-stadium/).
- League fixtures: 10; home matches: 5.
- Profile: Guyana retain Shimron Hetmyer, Romario Shepherd, Shai Hope and Shamar Joseph, while 10 of their 12 locally selected players come from Guyana.
- 2026 storyline: The Warriors close their home programme with five matches at Providence Stadium from 4 to 11 September, including the final match of the league phase.
- Published roster:

### [Jamaica Kingsmen](https://cplseason.com/team/jamaica-kingsmen/)

- Territory: Jamaica.
- Home venue: [Sabina Park](https://cplseason.com/venue/sabina-park/).
- League fixtures: 10; home matches: 4.
- Profile: The CPL's newest franchise restores a Jamaica-based men's team, led by a local group featuring Rovman Powell, Andre Russell and Odean Smith.
- 2026 storyline: The Kingsmen play the tournament opener and then bring CPL cricket back to Sabina Park for four home matches from 11 to 18 August.
- Published roster:

### [Saint Lucia Kings](https://cplseason.com/team/saint-lucia-kings/)

- Territory: Saint Lucia.
- Home venue: [Daren Sammy Cricket Ground](https://cplseason.com/venue/daren-sammy-cricket-ground/).
- League fixtures: 10; home matches: 5.
- Profile: Roston Chase and Matthew Forde anchor the returning group, joined by Jewel Andrew and a fresh Saint Lucian pathway that includes McKenny Clarke.
- 2026 storyline: Saint Lucia have the first five-match home block of the season at Daren Sammy Cricket Ground, running from 12 to 21 August.

### [St Kitts & Nevis Patriots](https://cplseason.com/team/st-kitts-nevis-patriots/)

- Territory: Saint Kitts and Nevis.
- Home venue: [Warner Park](https://cplseason.com/venue/warner-park/).
- League fixtures: 10; home matches: 4.
- Profile: The Patriots unite CPL's leading career run-scorer Johnson Charles with Andre Fletcher, while Jason Holder returns to strengthen an experienced Caribbean group.
- 2026 storyline: Warner Park hosts four Patriots matches from 27 August to 3 September, midway through a league campaign that starts in St Vincent.
- Published roster:

### [Trinbago Knight Riders](https://cplseason.com/team/trinbago-knight-riders/)

- Territory: Trinidad and Tobago.
- Home venue: [Brian Lara Cricket Academy](https://cplseason.com/venue/brian-lara-cricket-academy/).
- League fixtures: 10; home matches: 5.
- Profile: The 2025 champions retain a decorated core led by Sunil Narine, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard and Akeal Hosein as they pursue another title.
- 2026 storyline: Trinbago's five-match home block at Brian Lara Cricket Academy runs from 26 August to 2 September before the league-stage finish in Guyana.
- Published roster:

## Host venues

### [Arnos Vale Stadium](https://cplseason.com/venue/arnos-vale-stadium/)

- Location: Kingstown, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.
- Reference capacity: 18,000; scheduled matches: 3.
- Summary: Arnos Vale stages the first three CPL 2026 matches and brings the tournament to St Vincent and the Grenadines for the first time.

### [Brian Lara Cricket Academy](https://cplseason.com/venue/brian-lara-cricket-academy/)

- Location: Tarouba, Trinidad and Tobago.
- Reference capacity: 15,000; scheduled matches: 5.
- Summary: Brian Lara Cricket Academy hosts five Trinbago Knight Riders fixtures as the league moves into its Trinidad block.

### [Daren Sammy Cricket Ground](https://cplseason.com/venue/daren-sammy-cricket-ground/)

- Location: Gros Islet, Saint Lucia.
- Reference capacity: 12,400; scheduled matches: 5.
- Summary: Daren Sammy Cricket Ground carries five Saint Lucia league fixtures during a ten-day home block in August.

### [Kensington Oval](https://cplseason.com/venue/kensington-oval/)

- Location: Bridgetown, Barbados.

## Interpretation and freshness rules

- Use each page's visible update date, canonical URL, and status label.
- Treat `Scheduled` as a fixture state, not evidence that a match has started or finished.
- Treat unannounced playing XIs, results, standings, and territory-specific broadcasters as pending.
- Do not convert local match time without using the page's named IANA timezone.
- Prefer the current match page over summaries copied into older news articles.
- Prefer the points-table page for standings and the schedule page for current fixture order.
- Player inclusion on a published roster is not proof of availability for every match.
- Venue capacity is reference information, not ticket availability.
